q.l: November 2016: Opportunity School District (state takeover of failing schools)
q.d: Provides greater flexibility and state accountability to fix failing schools through increasing community involvement.

q.l: November 2016: Penalties for sexual exploitation; fund for child victims
q.d: Authorizes penalties for sexual exploitation and assessments on adult entertainment to fund child victims' services.

q.l: November 2016: Reconstitute the Judicial Qualifications Commission
q.d: Reforms and re-establishes the Judicial Qualifications Commission and provides for its composition, governance, and powers.

q.l: November 2016: Fireworks tax revenue to trauma care and fire services
q.d: Dedicates revenue from existing taxes on fireworks to trauma care, fire services, and public safety.

q.l: November 2016 President: Hillary Clinton vs. Donald J Trump
November 2016 U.S. Senate: Jim Barksdale vs. Johnny Isakson
November 2018: Georgia Outdoor Stewardship Trust Fund
q.d: Creates the Georgia Outdoor Stewardship Trust Fund to protect water quality, wildlife habitat, and parks.

q.l: November 2018: Statewide business court
q.d: Creates a state-wide business court to lower costs, enhance efficiency, and promote predictable judicial outcomes.

q.l: November 2018: Working-forest tax subclassification
q.d: Encourages the conservation, sustainability, and longevity of Georgia's working forests through tax subclassification and grants.

q.l: November 2018: Rights for victims of crime (Marsy's Law)
q.d: Provides rights for victims of crime in the judicial process.

q.l: November 2018: Sales tax allocation to county and city school districts
q.d: Authorizes fair allocation of sales tax proceeds to county and city school districts.

q.l: November 2018: Homestead exemption for residents of certain cities (Atlanta assessment freeze)
q.d: Provides for a homestead exemption for residents of certain municipal corporations.

q.l: November 2018: Tax exemption for homes for the mentally disabled
q.d: Provides a tax exemption for certain homes for the mentally disabled.

q.l: November 2020: Dedicate fees and taxes to their intended purpose
q.d: Summary (SOS page carries heading only): authorizes the General Assembly to dedicate revenues from fees or taxes to the public purpose for which they were intended.

q.l: November 2020: Waive sovereign immunity for unconstitutional acts
q.d: Summary: waives sovereign immunity so residents may seek declaratory relief from state and local acts that violate law or the constitution.

q.l: November 2020 President: Joseph R Biden vs. Donald J Trump
November 2020: Property tax exemption for charities building homes for low-income families
q.d: Summary: exempts from ad valorem taxation land held by purely public charities to build or repair single-family homes financed with no-interest loans to low-income individuals.

q.l: November 2020 U.S. Senate: Jon Ossoff vs. David A Perdue
January 2021 U.S. Senate: Jon Ossoff vs. David A Perdue
January 2021 U.S. Senate: Raphael Warnock vs. Kelly Loeffler
November 2022: Suspend pay of indicted state officials
q.d: Summary: suspends the compensation of members of the General Assembly and statewide officials suspended from office after a felony indictment.

q.l: November 2022: Temporary local tax relief for disaster-damaged property
q.d: Summary: lets local governments grant temporary property-tax relief to properties severely damaged by a declared natural disaster.

q.l: November 2022: Exempt timber harvesting equipment from property tax
q.d: Summary: exempts timber harvesting and processing equipment from ad valorem taxation.

q.l: November 2022: Expand farm-product and farm-equipment exemptions for family farms
q.d: Summary: expands the ad valorem exemption for agricultural equipment and certain farm products held by family-owned farm entities.

q.l: November 2022 U.S. Senate: Raphael Warnock vs. Herschel Junior Walker
December 2022 U.S. Senate: Raphael Warnock vs. Herschel Junior Walker
November 2024: Statewide homestead exemption capping assessment increases (local opt-out)
q.d: Summary: creates a statewide homestead exemption limiting annual increases in assessed value to inflation, with local governments allowed to opt out.

q.l: November 2024: Create the Georgia Tax Court
q.d: Summary: authorizes a statewide tax court with jurisdiction over specified tax cases.

q.l: November 2024 President: Kamala D Harris vs. Donald J Trump
November 2024: Raise personal-property tax exemption from $7500 to $20000
q.d: Summary: increases the exemption for tangible personal property (business inventory and equipment) from $7,500 to $20,000.
